title: Glowing crown
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff8b0' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd84a' stop-opacity='0.25'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd84a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe97a'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffc226'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8940a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='goldSide' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8940a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffc226'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='48' ry='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- crown body -->
  <path d='M20 72 L16 34 L34 50 L50 24 L66 50 L84 34 L80 72 Z' fill='url(#gold)'/>

  <!-- inner shading facets for clarity -->
  <path d='M20 72 L16 34 L34 50 Z' fill='url(#goldSide)' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M84 34 L80 72 L66 50 Z' fill='url(#goldSide)' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M34 50 L50 24 L66 50 Z' fill='#fff2a8' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- band -->
  <rect x='18' y='68' width='64' height='12' rx='5' fill='#ffd84a'/>
  <rect x='18' y='68' width='64' height='4' rx='2' fill='#fff4b8' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- jewels on band -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='74' r='3.4' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='73' r='1.1' fill='#ffc2cd'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='3.6' fill='#4dc3ff'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='73' r='1.2' fill='#c9efff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='74' r='3.4' fill='#6dff9c'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='73' r='1.1' fill='#d6ffe4'/>

  <!-- crown tip gems -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='31' r='1.3' fill='#ffd9bf'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='4.6' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='21' r='1.5' fill='#ffc2cd'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='31' r='1.3' fill='#ffd9bf'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M50 8 L52 14 L58 16 L52 18 L50 24 L48 18 L42 16 L48 14 Z' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <path d='M78 12 L79.4 16 L83.4 17.4 L79.4 18.8 L78 22.8 L76.6 18.8 L72.6 17.4 L76.6 16 Z' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M22 14 L23.2 17.6 L26.8 18.8 L23.2 20 L22 23.6 L20.8 20 L17.2 18.8 L20.8 17.6 Z' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
